title: Quick Replay
shortDescription: Instant replay and screen recording for Windows in one small Rust exe. No installer, no ffmpeg.
description: Tray app that keeps the last N seconds of your screen in RAM already compressed, then dumps a clip when you hit a shortcut. Also does normal recordings with optional mic and system audio. Uses Windows hardware encoders (NVENC, AMF, Quick Sync). Crash-safe segmented writes and a small library/player for clipping.
